name: What type of paint is best for exterior house painting?

mainEntity.name: What type of paint is best for exterior house painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: For exterior house painting, acrylic latex paints are generally considered the best choice due to their durability, flexibility, and resistance to cracking, fading, and mildew. They are water-based, making cleanup easier and drying faster. While oil-based paints offer excellent adhesion and a harder finish, they can become brittle over time and require mineral spirits for cleanup. High-quality acrylic latex paints are formulated to withstand harsh weather conditions, providing superior protection and longevity for your home's exterior.
acceptedAnswer.description: Acrylic latex paints are generally best for exterior house painting due to their durability, flexibility, and resistance to weather and mildew.
